description.blurb: S/2019 S 18 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Norse group. It was discovered in 2019 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2019 S 18 is about 3 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 23.1 million km in 1327.06 days. It has an inclination of 154.6° to the ecliptic in a retrograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.509.
